note: Adapter types for storing Raven receipts. ALL entries are documented_only — Raven implements none of them and requires none of them. For current receipt-v1, store the exact object plus the separate verifier result and index mintAddress, tokenProgramAddress, rulesVersion, slot, payloadHash and receiptId. Legacy v2 index examples are explicitly labelled. Verification works without storage.

adapters.name: local_file
adapters.notes: Simplest honest default: one JSON file per receipt, path = namespace.

adapters.name: sqlite
adapters.notes: Current receipt-v1: index on (mintAddress, tokenProgramAddress, rulesVersion, slot, payloadHash, receiptId). Legacy v2 compatibility only: (mintAddress, engineVersion, keyId, replayHash).

adapters.name: postgres
adapters.notes: JSONB for rawResponse; never expose credentials to clients.

adapters.name: object_storage
adapters.notes: Immutable buckets pair well with receipts.

adapters.name: vector_memory
adapters.notes: NEVER the source of truth: embeddings are derived. Keep rawResponse elsewhere; deterministic lookup beats fuzzy recall for receipts.

adapters.name: decentralized_storage
adapters.supports_revocation: encryption-key rotation (content itself may be permanent)
adapters.notes: Encrypt before upload; receipts may contain caller context.

adapters.name: walrus_harbor_optional
adapters.suitable_for: future durable/namespaced agent-memory storage IF a real beta user asks
adapters.secrets_required: provider keys — server-side proxy REQUIRED if ever used
adapters.notes: OPTIONAL FUTURE ADAPTER. No production integration exists and none is claimed. Raven does not depend on Walrus, Harbor, or Sui. Interface lesson only: namespaces, delegated access, restore-and-verify.

adapters.name: custom_agent_memory
adapters.notes: Follow /receipt-memory-policy.md: raw receipt intact, gaps visible, no secrets in memory.
